note: Free-tier limits on AI tools change often. Spot-check any tool whose facts drive a claim in a reel before publishing — especially numeric limits (credits, minutes, tokens).

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier with no daily hard cap on standard model access; handles writing, coding, analysis, and image generation inside the chat.

tools.name: Claude AI
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier with a 200K-token context window and PDF/document analysis.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier with a 2M-token context window and real-time web access.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.free_tier_fact: Free web-based assistant integrated with Microsoft 365 apps and Bing search.

tools.name: Perplexity AI
tools.free_tier_fact: Unlimited basic cited searches; roughly 3-5 advanced 'Pro Search' queries per day (no account required to start).

tools.name: NotebookLM
tools.free_tier_fact: Fully free for uploading your own documents and getting sourced summaries/answers from them.

tools.name: Google AI Studio
tools.free_tier_fact: Free access to Gemini models for building and testing prompts/apps.

tools.name: Hugging Face
tools.free_tier_fact: Free access to thousands of open-source AI models you can run or test in-browser.

tools.name: HuggingChat
tools.free_tier_fact: Fully free chatbot interface running open-source models, no subscription tier at all.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.free_tier_fact: Free plan includes 2,000 code completions and 50 chat/agent requests per month.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.free_tier_fact: Free grammar, spelling, and clarity checking across browser and desktop.

tools.name: QuillBot
tools.free_tier_fact: Free paraphrasing and grammar checking with a per-rewrite word-count limit on the free plan.

tools.name: Wordtune
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier gives a limited number of AI rewrite suggestions per month.

tools.name: Copy.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier for short-form marketing copy, captions, and email drafts.

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.free_tier_fact: Notion's free workspace plan includes limited built-in AI writing/summarizing credits.

tools.name: Canva
tools.free_tier_fact: Free design platform with built-in AI image generation and editing tools.

tools.name: Microsoft Designer
tools.free_tier_fact: Free AI image generation and design templates, includes free background removal.

tools.name: DALL-E
tools.free_tier_fact: Accessible free inside ChatGPT's free tier for AI image generation.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.free_tier_fact: Occasionally runs limited free trial generations; primarily subscription-based (verify current offer before promoting as 'free').

tools.name: Leonardo.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free daily token allowance (roughly 150 fast tokens/day) for AI image generation.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.free_tier_fact: Free daily credits for AI image generation, known for accurately rendering text in images.

tools.name: Remove.bg
tools.free_tier_fact: Free background removal at standard resolution; HD downloads require credits.

tools.name: Photoroom
tools.free_tier_fact: Free background removal and product-photo editing on mobile and web.

tools.name: Vectorizer.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier allows a limited number of image-to-vector conversions before requiring payment.

tools.name: CapCut
tools.free_tier_fact: Free video editor with AI captions, templates, and effects, no watermark on exports.

tools.name: RunwayML
tools.free_tier_fact: New users get a limited one-time free credit allowance for AI video generation and editing tools.

tools.name: Kapwing
tools.free_tier_fact: Free online video editor with AI auto-captions; free exports carry a watermark and length cap.

tools.name: Veed.io
tools.free_tier_fact: Free online video editor with AI tools; free tier has export/watermark limits.

tools.name: Descript
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier includes limited transcription minutes for text-based video/audio editing.

tools.name: Kling AI
tools.free_tier_fact: Free daily credit allowance (roughly 66 credits/day) for AI text-to-video generation.

tools.name: Bing Image Creator
tools.free_tier_fact: Free AI image generation via Microsoft account with a daily fast-generation credit allowance.

tools.name: Suno.com
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier lets you generate a limited number of AI songs per day.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier includes a limited monthly character allowance for realistic AI text-to-speech.

tools.name: Murf.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier includes limited voiceover minutes per month.

tools.name: Gamma.app
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier turns notes into presentations, documents, or webpages with a limited number of AI credits.

tools.name: Tome
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier for AI-generated presentations and narrative decks.

tools.name: Napkin.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier turns written text into visuals, diagrams, and graphics.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free plan includes 300 transcription minutes/month, capped at 30 minutes per conversation.

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free plan offers unlimited transcription and AI summaries, capped at 400 minutes of team-wide storage.

tools.name: Fathom
tools.free_tier_fact: Vendor states unlimited free meeting recording and summaries on its free plan (confirm current terms before publishing).

tools.name: ChatPDF
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier lets you upload PDFs and ask questions, with a daily upload/page limit.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier for AI-powered search and synthesis of academic research papers.

tools.name: Elicit
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier for AI-assisted literature review and research summarization.

tools.name: DeepL
tools.free_tier_fact: Free translation tool with a per-translation character limit, widely regarded as more accurate than Google Translate for nuance.

tools.name: Character.AI
tools.free_tier_fact: Free access to AI chatbot personas for conversation and roleplay.

tools.name: Poe
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier gives access to multiple AI chatbots (from different companies) in one interface, with daily message limits.

tools.name: Krea.ai
tools.free_tier_fact: Free tier for real-time AI image generation and enhancement.

tools.name: Pika
tools.free_tier_fact: Free daily credit allowance for AI video generation from text or images.

tools.name: n8n
tools.free_tier_fact: Free when self-hosted; a no-code workflow automation alternative to paid tools like Zapier.
